name: Kahyun Kim
bio: Kahyun Kim is a talented actress known for her roles in various TV shows and movies. She has appeared in projects like "Cocaine Bear" (2023), "American Gods" (2017), and "Freaky Friday" (2018). Originally from South Korea, she moved to the United States at the age of 16 and attended the prestigious Juilliard School. Recently, she has been starring in the NBC comedy series "St. Denis Medical" as Serena, a registered nurse.

credits.overview: When a flesh hungry stranger and a closeted husband connect through a kink app, what begins as sexual exploration spirals into a night of primal horror…proving that in the digital age, the most dangerous appetite is the one we choose to indulge.

credits.title: Ages of Man
credits.overview: An anthology fiction short where three men find themselves in vulnerable positions with three women. This comedic horror drops the audience in the middle of stories about the invisible labor that women perform every day, the labor that makes the world go round.

credits.title: Every 9 Hours
credits.overview: An exploration of race and gender examines how prejudice and privilege shape relationships and daily life.
